answer: An identity may vote only while it keeps a live signal. Every epoch a random probe must be signed by that key inside a short window; the transcripts accumulate as a lotus of dated petals, and a missed or late petal zeros weight and slashes a locked deposit. Funding source and host clock are etched on a public marble, so two keys that share a wallet or tick in lock-step are treated as one body and both lose the stake. A farm must keep every alias awake, separately funded, and unsynchronized; sleeping copies earn nothing and still burn capital.
